The trigonal compound Mg18Cu3Sb3 (reduced formula Mg6CuSb) crystallizes in space group R-3m (No. 166), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Mg centers 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Cu and Sb each have 10 neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and face-sharing between Mg 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Cu 10-vertex and Mg 12-vertex polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
